channel.title: The Grant Desk - next 30 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: next 30 days, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 15 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: HIAP: Ukraine Solidarity Residencies Programme 2027 (Finland)
item.description: HIAP (Helsinki International Artist Programme) and partner residencies · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Working grant of EUR 1,200 per month (EUR 1,200 to 3,600 depending on residency length), plus free living and working space, one return trip from the artist's home, and a small access budget for disabled artists. No application fee.

item.title: Inciter Art (Fractured Atlas): quarterly open call for essays, 'tending to the hearth' (USD 750 stipend)
item.description: Fractured Atlas (Inciter Art) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · USD 750 stipend per selected writer, paid by ACH deposit or check once the first draft is finished (a W-9 form is required). No submission fee.

item.description: HIAP Helsinki International Artist Programme, with Sumud - The Finnish Palestine Network · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · EUR 3,600 working grant, a free 63 sqm live/work studio, one return trip, and a visa budget covering application fees and visa-office travel. No application fee.

item.title: MIT Solve: 2027 Global Challenges
item.description: MIT Solve (Massachusetts Institute of Technology) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Every selected Solver team receives a USD 10,000 grant funded by Solve, plus access to a pool of over USD 1 million in prize funding at selection and additional funding opportunities throughout the program. Sponsor prizes range from USD 100,000 to 200,000, including the AI for Humanity Prize (up to USD 150,000, Patrick J. McGovern Foundation), the Collegium Prize for Innovation (USD 100,000), the Citizens Workforce Innovation Prize (USD 100,000), the Crescent Enterprises AI for Social Innovation Prize (USD 100,000) and the Seeding the Future Prize (USD 150,000). item.description: Asian Cultural Council · deadline 10 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 35,000 for self-directed exploration and cultural exchange of 1 to 6 months. Single or joint applications (up to 3 participants). No application fee.

item.description: Swarovski Foundation · deadline 09 Nov 2026 · EUR 20,000 grant per selected participant, plus a mentorship and education programme. No application fee.

item.description: Beam Center · deadline 30 Nov 2026 · USD 5,000 award to the selected proposer, plus a fabrication budget of approximately USD 15,000. No application fee.

item.title: EFFEA Call #5: European Festivals Fund for Emerging Artists
item.description: European Festivals Association (EFA) · deadline 03 Nov 2026 · 50 residency grants: 40 Discovery grants of EUR 8,000 (for artists at an early career stage) and 10 Springboard grants of EUR 15,000 (for artists established at home and ready to break through internationally). A minimum of 80 percent of the grant must cover costs incurred by the artists (fees, travel, accommodation, subsistence). An own contribution of EUR 1,000 (Discovery) or EUR 2,000 (Springboard) is deducted from the paid grant. No application fee.

item.title: Harry Ransom Center Research Fellowships 2027-2028 (Austin, Texas)

International recipients get an extra USD 500. No application fee.

item.title: KHK CURE Fellowships 2027/2028, Saarland University (theme: Things)
item.description: Kaete Hamburger Centre for Cultural Practices of Reparation (CURE), Saarland University · deadline 30 Nov 2026 · Up to twelve fellowships. Fellows on unpaid leave from their institution receive approximately EUR 6,100 to 7,200 per month before taxes, depending on qualifications; alternatively, fellows retaining their salary can have their home institution reimbursed for replacement teaching. One round trip to Saarbruecken is reimbursed, a fully equipped individual workspace is provided, and an apartment can be arranged for around EUR 1,250 per month. Eligible accompanying family members may receive additional support. No application fee.

item.title: Est-Nord-Est Artist Residency 2027-2028 (Saint-Jean-Port-Joli, Quebec)
item.description: Est-Nord-Est, residence d'artistes · deadline 08 Nov 2026 · CAD 2,080 residency honorarium, plus a free individual studio-workshop with lodging, access to specialized wood, metal and ceramics equipment, a documentation center, and technical, artistic and logistical support. item.title: A.I.R. Gallery: Fellowship Program 2027-2028 (NYC)

Gallery, 4 to 5 professional development workshops, an assigned artist-mentor, a studio visit with a review panelist and ongoing staff support. Six fellows selected. No application fee stated.

item.title: Nieman Fellowships at Harvard, Class of 2028
item.description: Nieman Foundation for Journalism at Harvard · deadline 01 Dec 2026 · USD 87,500 stipend paid over the nine-month academic year (2026-27 figure), plus additional allowances for housing, childcare and health insurance. Fellows audit courses across Harvard and participate in Nieman seminars, master classes and workshops. No application fee.

item.title: UCLA Modern Endangered Archives Program (MEAP): 2026-27 Call for Applications
item.description: UCLA Library, Modern Endangered Archives Program · deadline 16 Nov 2026 · Planning Grants up to USD 20,000 (up to 1 year) for collection evaluation, survey and inventory work before digitization. Project Grants up to USD 70,000 (up to 2 years) for digitization and metadata creation on well-organized collections, or curation of existing digital assets. Regional Grants up to USD 100,000 (up to 2 years) for digital collections drawing on three or more institutions, families or repositories around one theme, hosted by an organization with prior MEAP experience. A separate AV Grants track (up to USD 100,000, for audio, video and film) opens in April 2027. No application fee.

item.title: ARC Prize 2026
item.description: ARC Prize Foundation · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · USD 2,000,000 total prize pool across three tracks (ARC-AGI-2, ARC-AGI-3 agents, and a paper prize); milestone prizes include USD 25,000 / 10,000 / 2,500
